title: TShock
tagline: Modded Terraria server with advanced management
author: Tachy
description: TShock is an open-source Terraria server offering user and group management, anti-cheat, protected regions, a SQLite database, and a full REST API for remote administration.

GAME_PORT.title: Terraria Port
GAME_PORT.description: TCP port on which Terraria clients connect.

postInstallMessage:
## TShock installed!

The Terraria server is available on port **$GAME_PORT**.

The REST API is accessible at: **$CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN**

First start:
1. Check the logs to get the `/setup` code
2. Connect to the Terraria server and run `/setup <code>`
3. Your REST superadmin token is in `/app/data/rest-api-credentials.txt`

setup-admin.message: Get the `/setup` code from the logs and run it in-game to create the admin account.
